usedFor: Box holds the files and tasks, and Bolna places a call once “Task Assigned to you” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “Task Assigned to you” in Box, then “Make a Phone Call” in Bolna
bestTemplate.why: A task handed to you is worth a call, and the action starts one with no manual step.

watchOut: Box triggers such as “New File” are polling, so “Make a Phone Call” runs after a scheduled check.
